content.short: Coin98 Wallet is a multi-chain 'super app' that integrates TON for asset management, swaps, and dApp access.
content.description: Coin98 Wallet is a versatile 'super app' designed to bridge users to the multi-chain future, now with full integration for the TON blockchain. It offers a comprehensive suite of tools for managing assets, performing cross-chain swaps, and accessing a vast array of decentralized applications. By supporting multiple blockchains natively, Coin98 Wallet simplifies the complex landscape of Web3, providing a unified and secure interface for users to explore the TON ecosystem and beyond.
content.meta: Experience the multi-chain future with Coin98 Wallet. Manage TON assets and explore dApps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
